source.title: Night City 2045
source.note: Direct source review of all seven Executive Zone rows the v0.2 audit classified CONTEXT_ONLY. A source-explicit Fixer operation is separated from the residential Estates. Factual metadata and concise paraphrases only; source prose is not reproduced.

entities.name: The Estates
entities.source_summary: Collection of roughly twenty highly secured private estates; the mapped location is residential rather than a retail operation, but one listed resident provides a source-explicit procurement service.

entities.name: Mister Kernaghan Procurement Service
entities.source_summary: Mister Kernaghan is identified as a prominent high-end Fixer able to source whatever Executive Zone residents require.

services.label: High-end procurement and sourcing for Executive Zone clients

entities.name: Firebird Tearoom & Steam Baths
entities.source_summary: Opulent Slavic-style tearoom and steam-bath business serving teas, sweets and snacks alongside private sauna and cold-plunge facilities.

services.label: Steam baths, sauna and cold-plunge facilities

entities.name: Groundskeeper Shed
entities.source_summary: Internal operations site where district groundskeepers remotely manage irrigation, fertilization and landscaping drones; no public customer service is stated.

entities.name: Growing Shoots Daycare
entities.source_summary: Premium childcare business described as Night City’s most expensive daycare, assigning individual caretakers and tightly structured activities to children.

services.label: High-security premium daycare and individual caretaker service

entities.name: HOA Offices
entities.source_summary: Administrative offices and records facility for the Executive Zone homeowners association; no public commercial service is established.

entities.name: Lazarus Base of Operations
entities.source_summary: Dedicated Lazarus security compound supporting its Executive Zone contract with barracks, armory, training area, records and offices; it is an internal base rather than a public storefront.

entities.name: Monorail Station
entities.source_summary: Restricted high-speed transport service for senior corporate executives, operated and secured by Lazarus and accessed through CIN-backed corporate status.
